scope.summary: Correct the Add person form grid action sizing, add responsive layout regression coverage, and document the verified action placement.
implemented: The EmployeeForm primary action uses a content-sized, 44px-minimum grid footer row and aligns to the form's right edge.
Responsive browser assertions cover button height, placement, Cancel visibility, horizontal overflow, keyboard focus, and the unchanged employee submit flow at four viewport widths.
The role-based user guide documents the compact action and Cancel placement.

criteria.description: Add employee button uses a compact, consistent height rather than stretching to match the adjacent form row.

evidence.outcome: The employee profile browser case passed with button height asserted at 44–48px at 375, 768, 1024, and 1440px.

criteria.description: Button is correctly placed and aligned with Cancel on desktop and mobile layouts.

evidence.outcome: At all four widths the action's right edge matched the form's right edge; Cancel remained visible below the action without overlap.

criteria.description: No awkward empty button space or oversized dark block remains.

evidence.outcome: The browser case passed content-sized width and compact-height assertions at all four viewports.

criteria.description: Accessible focus, disabled, loading and submit behavior continue working.

evidence.outcome: The button received focus and the existing double-submit creation flow passed.
People loading and failed-save recovery passed in the full browser fallback; the shared SaveButton implementation was unchanged.
SaveButton still uses useFormStatus to disable pending submissions and display its saving label.

criteria.description: Visual regression or component tests cover desktop and mobile layouts.

evidence.outcome: The full fallback passed 108 browser cases with 1 skipped and 0 failed or flaky; the responsive employee profile case passed.
